summary: Your drive and your discipline support each other when you choose to use them. The capacity for steady, deliberate effort is right there. It works best through practice.
body: Your drive and your discipline support each other when you choose to use them. The capacity for steady, deliberate effort is right there. It works best through practice. Left idle, your energy scatters or stalls. But when you put structure around the drive, a plan, a rep, a deadline, you become quietly unstoppable. The opening pays out every time you take it. Build the habit and the habit builds you.
gift: At your best: deliberate, durable, capable of real follow-through.
shadow: The trap: scattering the energy instead of giving it a structure to run on.
integration: Let drive and anger and discipline and limits cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Endurance and discipline; the friction is the constant start-stop of push against restraint.
do: Put a structure around the drive
Take the opening instead of waiting for motivation
